title: Rewrite TypeScript exportDesignModel with gltf-transform
description: Rewrite exportDesignModel in semio/js/semio.ts to use @gltf-transform/core instead of manual GLB construction. Remove parseGlb, buildGlb, blobToArrayBuffer, mergeGlbModel. Keep EXPORT_MODEL_FORMATS, function signature, BFS traversal logic.
summary: Rewrote exportDesignModel in semio/js/semio.ts to use @gltf-transform/core instead of manual GLB binary construction. Removed parseGlb, buildGlb, blobToArrayBuffer, mergeGlbModel functions. Added import for Document, NodeIO, Accessor, Primitive, Buffer, Mesh, Node, Scene, Material, Texture from @gltf-transform/core. Added decodeBlobToBytes (base64 decoder), copyGltfTexture, copyGltfMaterial, copyGltfMeshes (deep-copy mesh data between documents), createBoxMesh (unit box placeholder). Rewrote exportDesignModel to: create a GltfDocument, read source GLB files via io.readBinary(), copy mesh data into target doc via copyGltfMeshes, build scene graph with GltfNode hierarchy and setMatrix for transforms, output via io.writeBinary() for .glb or io.writeJSON() for .gltf. Kept EXPORT_MODEL_FORMATS, planeToGlbTransform, findMatchingModel, function signature, BFS traversal, connection hierarchy, relative transform logic. All 18 tests pass.
